A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Spiideo

Club pays for a coaching tool

SpiideoPremium

Malmö, Sweden · founded 2012 · active · www.spiideo.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolFixed multi-lensDeployed in ItalyEvidence BQuote only

Spiideo installs cloud-connected fixed cameras (S-Line, X-Line, A-Line) on pitches and arenas and sells two cloud products on top, Spiideo Perform for coaches and analysts and Spiideo Play for automated live production with graphics, replay and commentary sp-08, sp-19.

For Professional and semi-professional clubs, academies, universities and leagues that want permanent multi-pitch capture with no server on site and a shared video and data workflow, with the A-Line launched in 2026 as the cheaper route for smaller venues sp-03, sp-14. Grassroots teams with one pitch and one camera budget are served better by the portable vendors, since Spiideo publishes no list price and sells by quote sp-19, sp-08.

Spiideo exists because clubs with several pitches wanted the whole training ground recorded every day, and a PoE camera feeding a cloud platform removed both the operator and the server room sp-14, sp-09. It matters now because revenue reached 243 million Swedish kronor in 2025 with losses still at 56 million, a 20 million dollar round in 2024 and the Signality tracking acquisition point to a company buying its way into data, and AI Highlights in May 2026 shows production automation moving from camera control to editorial sp-06, sp-01, sp-02, sp-04. That tells you the space is splitting, with one camp selling cheap capture to amateurs and Spiideo betting that leagues and academies will pay for capture, data and broadcast in one cloud sp-04, sp-05.

Price band Quote-only; the one published partner price is USD 1,875 per team package for 25 games with AutoData stats and 50 hours of storage in a US hockey programme, and Spiideo claims the A-Line is up to 44 percent cheaper than comparable systems sp-13

Italy AS Roma automates capture on four training pitches with Spiideo Perform, the Milan youth academy SSD Ausonia 1931 installed cameras on three pitches on Inter's recommendation, and Spiideo lists Italy as a remote office location and offers Italian on its support site sp-14, sp-15, sp-16, sp-23.

The verdict

Look if You run an academy or club with several pitches, a full-time analyst and a stadium or arena where live production with graphics and replay is part of the plan, and you want no server on site sp-14, sp-18. You are a league or conference that wants a video exchange, replay for officials and automated production across many venues on one contract sp-05, sp-19.

Skip if You want to know the price before talking to sales, because Spiideo publishes no list price and the only public figure is a US hockey partner package sp-13. You want a portable camera you can carry to away matches for under 1,500 euros, since the Portable SmartCam weighs under eight kilograms and sits inside the same quote-based model sp-10.

Watch-outs

  • Custom downloads with a chosen view, including the panorama, require the Pro Plus tier, take around 20 minutes to render and expire after seven days sp-12.
  • The A-Line needs PoE+ at 30 watts, a cabled connection and at least 15 megabits per second of upload per camera, so pitch cabling is part of the project sp-07.
  • The public privacy policy dates from June 2022, names Spiideo as controller for its own users and says nothing about people filmed, hosting region, sub-processors or a data processing agreement sp-17.
  • The company lost 55.7 million kronor in 2025 on 243.3 million of revenue and equity fell from 180.7 million to 127.0 million kronor during the year sp-06.
  • The Spiideo consumer app has nine App Store ratings, several of which describe frozen paid streams, so the fan-facing layer is thin compared with the coaching layer sp-21.
  • The 44 percent cheaper claim for the A-Line has no published reference price attached to it sp-03.

Products

  • Spiideo S-Line mark III (camera). Fixed multi-4K camera system at up to 50 or 60 fps, 170 degree view, indoor and outdoor, cloud-connected with no local server sp-09, sp-08.
  • Spiideo X-Line (camera). High-end fixed 4K system with Canon optics, 70 to 170 degree view and IP66 or IP67 protection sp-08.
  • Spiideo A-Line (camera). Compact 2K panoramic camera with optical zoom on a single PoE+ cable, launched March 2026 as the lower-cost option for sideline and goal-line positions sp-03, sp-07.
  • Portable SmartCam (camera). Battery-powered 180 degree camera under eight kilograms with Wi-Fi and 4G upload for away matches sp-10.
  • Spiideo Perform (platform). Cloud video analysis with AutoFollow views, tagging, presentations and MP4 downloads across League Exchange, Lite, Pro and Pro Plus tiers sp-11, sp-12.
  • Spiideo Play and CloudStudio (platform). Automated live production with multi-camera switching, replay, commentary, graphics, OTT with payments and sponsor placement sp-18, sp-19.
  • AI Highlights (add-on). Automated story-driven highlight packages for soccer, ice hockey, basketball and handball, launched 5 May 2026 as a Play add-on sp-04.
  • AutoData (add-on). Optical tracking statistics built on the Signality acquisition, sold per game in partner packages sp-02, sp-13.
  • Spiideo Replay (platform). Cloud replay for officials with remote collaboration, deployed at conference scale in US college sport sp-05, sp-19.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
Spiideo sells to professional clubs, academies, universities and leagues, with AS Roma, Brentford, Livingston and San Diego Loyal as named football users and the NBA, NHL, Premier League and NCAA among its markets sp-19, sp-22. The product set covers analysis (Perform), production (Play with CloudStudio), officiating (Replay), video exchange (League Exchange) and data (AutoData) sp-19. Youth academies such as Ausonia 1931 in Milan and IFK Stocksund use it for multi-pitch training capture and streamed matches sp-15, sp-19.
Capture quality
The S-Line mark III records multiple 4K streams at up to 50 or 60 frames per second with a larger sensor claimed to double low-light performance and a 170 degree view, and the X-Line uses Canon optics with 4K per camera and IP66 or IP67 protection sp-09, sp-08. The A-Line captures at 2K with a 180 degree panorama, optical zoom and 25 or 30 frames per second from 3 to 20 metres off the sideline sp-08, sp-03. The Portable SmartCam offers an ultra-wide 180 degree view over Wi-Fi or 4G sp-10.
Automation accuracy
AutoFollow tracking is tuned for more than 15 sports and Perform offers fixed, panorama, standard, wide, all-players and custom-area follow views for the same recording sp-18, sp-12. The Signality acquisition added optical tracking and real-time data generation, which now feeds AutoData and the AI Highlights product launched in May 2026 sp-02, sp-04. Spiideo publishes no accuracy metrics, and coach testimonials speak to time saved and say nothing about tracking precision sp-14, sp-19.
Multi-angle and stitching
Perform lets users choose which camera angle to download when several cameras cover one scene, and CloudStudio switches between AI cameras and third-party cameras, drones and manual feeds in one production sp-12, sp-18. Virtual Panorama stitches full-field coverage on multi-sensor units sp-14, sp-03. This is the widest multi-angle capability among the four vendors in this batch sp-18.
Latency and live readiness
Spiideo Play with CloudStudio produces live with instant replay, commentary, data-triggered graphics, region-specific branding, clean feeds and a low-latency option for sportsbooks sp-18. Commentator Mode added in August 2026 gives commentators the produced feed and microphone control only sp-05. No latency figures are published, and the consumer app reviews report freezing on paid streams sp-18, sp-21.
Reliability and resilience
Cameras are outbound-only devices on DHCP that need HTTPS, NTP and a short list of TCP and UDP ports, and Spiideo says systems update themselves with no local server sp-07, sp-09. Spiideo claims more than 7,000 arenas and conference-scale replay deployments across 12 Southland institutions now in their second season sp-04, sp-05. No uptime figures or status page were found sp-23.
Portability and install
Fixed lines connect by Ethernet up to 100 metres, fibre up to 1,000 metres or a line-of-sight wireless link, and the A-Line runs on a single PoE+ cable with surge protection advised outdoors sp-24, sp-07. The Portable SmartCam weighs under eight kilograms and sets up in under ten minutes sp-10. Installation is a cabling project, which is the price of permanent daily capture sp-24.
Connectivity and bandwidth
The A-Line needs at least 15 megabits per second upload per camera or footage is delayed or downgraded sp-07. Fixed cameras require a wired or fibre backhaul and the portable unit uses Wi-Fi or 4G with 5G announced sp-24, sp-10. Everything uploads to the cloud, so a multi-pitch site needs upload capacity sized for concurrent sessions sp-09.
Workflow and UX
Perform offers tagging, smart search, clip collections, opponent scouting, presentations and, in 2026, a tag length editor and auto-notes on tags sp-13, sp-05. Downloads are standalone H.264 MP4 files across tiers with view selection reserved to Pro Plus sp-12. Brentford reports saving 10 to 12 hours per week and Roma reports removing 10 hours of sideline filming weekly sp-19, sp-14.
Analysis layer
AutoData provides advanced statistics per game, priced in the Black Bear hockey programme at 75 dollars per game inside a 1,875 dollar 25-game package sp-13. Signality's optical tracking underpins the data layer since December 2024 sp-02. Perform tiers run League Exchange, Lite, Pro and Pro Plus with feature matrices published as images, so they cannot be searched or copied sp-11.
Integrations
Spiideo runs a developer portal with an API reference and authentication guide, and its AI Highlights were built with the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center on Amazon Bedrock sp-20, sp-04. CloudStudio ingests third-party cameras and delivers clean feeds to partners sp-18. No named integration with Hudl Sportscode or Wyscout appears on the clubs page sp-19.
Distribution and OTT
Spiideo Play includes an OTT service with payment integration and sponsor placement, and RED.Sport Network covers more than 50 leagues on it sp-19, sp-18. The IWSOC National Video Exchange for more than 350 NCAA Division I women's soccer programmes went live in August 2026 with Spiideo as provider sp-05. AI Highlights packages clips for different platforms as an add-on to Play sp-04.
Data access and ownership
Downloads produce a standalone MP4 with the chosen view, but custom downloads are limited to Pro Plus subscribers and expire after seven days sp-12. The privacy policy states business data is kept for the duration of the agreement, and no public terms describe what happens to footage after termination sp-17. Not assessable further from public sources.
Privacy and compliance
The public privacy policy, last updated 7 June 2022, treats Spiideo AB as controller for account holders and marketing contacts and does not address people appearing in footage, minors, hosting region, transfer mechanisms or a data processing agreement sp-17. No blurring, consent or opt-out tooling is documented on the help centre sp-23. Not assessable further from public sources.
Security
Spiideo documents outbound-only camera traffic on specific ports and cloud-hosted processing, and its AI Highlights run on AWS services sp-07, sp-04. No SOC 2, ISO 27001, penetration test statement or security page was found on the public site sp-23. Not assessable further from public sources.
Pricing and TCO
Spiideo sells by quote, and the one public package is 1,875 dollars per team for 25 games with AutoData and 50 hours of storage through Black Bear Sports Group in US hockey sp-13. The A-Line is positioned as up to 44 percent cheaper than comparable solutions without a reference price sp-03. Budget for PoE+ switching, cabling and 15 megabits of upload per camera on top of the subscription sp-07.
Support and service
The help centre runs in English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Spanish and Swedish with a chat widget and a training library called the Spiideo Academy sp-23. No support hours, SLAs or warranty terms are published sp-23. Not assessable further from public sources.
Company health and roadmap
Spiideo AB, registered 556883-4435, grew revenue from 74.2 million kronor in 2021 to 243.3 million in 2025 while losing between 38.4 and 72.2 million kronor every year, with equity of 127.0 million kronor at the end of 2025 sp-06. It raised 20 million dollars in June 2024 led by Cipio Partners with Mathias Kamprad, taking total funding to 40 million dollars, acquired Signality in December 2024 and was named to the Sifted 100 Nordics list in September 2026 sp-01, sp-02, sp-05. Product cadence in 2026 shows the A-Line, AI Highlights, Commentator Mode, auto-notes and the tag length editor sp-03, sp-04, sp-05.
Evidence and references
AS Roma automates four training pitches and quotes its video analyst on workflow gains, and Ausonia 1931 in Milan installed three pitches on Inter's recommendation sp-14, sp-15. Brentford, Livingston and San Diego Loyal are named football users and the Southland Conference runs replay across 12 institutions and seven sports sp-19, sp-05. Spiideo claims more than 7,000 arenas, more than 4,000 organisations and around 200 employees in 12 countries sp-04, sp-16.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Named analysts at Roma and Brentford report large weekly time savings sp-14, sp-19. Public review volume is negligible, with nine App Store ratings at 4.3 dominated by fan complaints about frozen paid streams and no reviews on SourceForge sp-21. Not assessable at scale from public sources.
Edge versus cloud
All cameras are cloud-connected with no local server, and AutoFollow, AutoData and AI Highlights run in Spiideo's cloud on AWS sp-09, sp-04. Cameras upload continuously and degrade quality when upload speed is short, so the site link is the bottleneck, with on-camera compute playing no part sp-07. Replay for officials runs from the same cloud with remote collaboration to on-field officials sp-05.
Accessibility and languages
The help centre and support run in seven languages including Italian, and Spiideo lists Italy as a remote office location with staff in 12 countries sp-23, sp-16. Around half of revenue comes from North America sp-01.
Upgrade path
A club can start on a single A-Line with Perform Lite and move up to Pro Plus, add AutoData per game, and later add Play with CloudStudio for live production and Replay for officials on the same cameras sp-03, sp-11, sp-18. Leagues add League Exchange and AI Highlights as add-ons sp-11, sp-04. The path runs inside one cloud account, which is the main argument for paying more up front sp-19.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the custom-area AutoFollow and multi-angle download on a training session, because that is where the fixed multi-camera design pays off sp-12. Test AI Highlights on a full match and judge whether the story cuts are publishable without an editor sp-04. Ask for the price of the A-Line against a Veo Cam 3 plus Club plan and check the 44 percent claim sp-03.

Company

Ownership and funding Spiideo AB is a private Swedish company co-founded by CEO Patrik Olsson and chairman Örjan Johansson that raised 20 million dollars in June 2024 led by Cipio Partners with Mathias Kamprad, Tassaka AB and Roosgruppen AB, bringing total funding to 40 million dollars sp-01, sp-22.

Financials Swedish filings show revenue of 74.2 million kronor in 2021, 108.1 million in 2022, 142.7 million in 2023, 198.5 million in 2024 and 243.3 million in 2025, with net losses of 47.8, 64.7, 72.2, 38.4 and 55.7 million kronor respectively and equity of 127.0 million kronor at the end of 2025 sp-06.

Scale, company-stated May 2026: more than 7,000 arenas sp-04. June 2024: more than 6,000 venues, 4,000 teams, 60 countries and around half of revenue from North America sp-01. Careers site: around 200 employees in 12 countries and more than 4,000 organisations and leagues sp-16.
